page_title: RMA 5-1 BET | Real Madrid v Betis 04/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' 5 - 1 Goal! Federico Valverde puts a cross into the box and finds Fran Garcia (Real Madrid), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner. He makes it 5:1.
90+3' Real Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+1' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) cracked a first-time shot, but the goalkeeper pulled off an amazing save.
90+1' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' Xabi Alonso decides to make a substitution. Antonio Rudiger will be replaced by Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid).
88' Substitution. Gonzalo Garcia walks off the pitch and Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
88' That will be all from Antony who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Pablo Garcia (Betis).
82' 4 - 1 GOAL! Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) finishes off a sublime move with a delightful back-heel goal. Arda Guler provided the assist with a brilliant pass. 4:1.
82' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
81' Xabi Alonso has decided to substitute Aurelien Tchouameni and he is replaced by Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid).
77' The referee allows time for a substitution. Rodrygo will be replaced by Arda Guler (Real Madrid).
77' The referee signals a substitution. Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) is brought on as a substitute for Vinicius Junior.
77' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
76' Betis quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
76' Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the right post. A few inches to the left and it could have been a sweet goal!
74' Antony (Betis) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

73' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the target, but Alvaro Valles keeps the ball out.
70' The attendance for today's match is 75190.
70' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Antony (Betis), whose low effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
68' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis), whose effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
67' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) replaces Aitor Ruibal.
67' The game has come to an end for Marc Roca. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Sergi Altimira (Betis).
66' 3 - 1 Cucho Hernandez (Betis) bursts into the box after a great solo run and gets one-on-one with the keeper, who he neatly side steps and rolls the ball into an empty net. Wonderful effort!
65' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
64' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Thibaut Courtois makes a comfortable save.

63' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to rifle a shot into the middle of the goal, but Alvaro Valles makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.

63' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Marc Roca (Betis) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Thibaut Courtois pulls off an easy save.
63' Betis take a short corner kick.
63' Hector Bellerin (Betis) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Betis can continue in their attacking effort.
62' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) produces a decent strike goalwards from the resulting set piece. His effort rattles the left post and the ball stays out of the net. The goalkeeper was quite lucky!
60' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) sends the corner into the box, but Thibaut Courtois intercepts it and averts the threat.
59' Antony (Betis) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Corner kick. Betis will have an opportunity.

58' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Alvaro Valles!
56' 3 - 0 Goal! Rodrygo launched the corner kick and superbly found the head of Raul Asencio (Real Madrid), whose accurate effort from near the penalty spot went into the top right corner. It's 3:0.
56' The ball is out of play and Real Madrid manage to earn a corner.
53' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) for a tough tackle.

50' 2 - 0 Federico Valverde sends a lovely ball into Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid). He latches on to it and shoots inside the left post from the edge of the box. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 2:0.
48' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Madrid, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
48' Natan (Betis) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Real Madrid.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Manuel Pellegrini gives a chance to Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) and Nelson Deossa is off.
46' Manuel Pellegrini makes a switch. Hector Bellerin is coming on in place of Angel Ortiz (Betis) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Pablo Fornals (Betis) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
45+2' Pablo Fornals (Betis) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. It will be a corner kick for Betis.
45+1' Betis work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45+1' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Pablo Fornals (Betis). The ball goes out of play. Betis are awarded a corner kick.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Flag goes up against Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
44' The ball rebounds out to Nelson Deossa (Betis) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
44' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.
43' Angel Ortiz (Betis) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Now Betis have a corner.
42' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar.
41' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
40' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
39' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post.
34' Nelson Deossa (Betis) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
29' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
28' Betis fail to score from a corner as Thibaut Courtois (Real Madrid) leaps to collect the ball.
28' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Good work from Betis as they win a corner.
26' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
26' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.

24' What a poor attempt! Nelson Deossa (Betis) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right.
22' Antony (Betis) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.

20' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Rodrygo flights the free kick into the box, where Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) peels off his marker and heads straight into the left side of the net from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 1:0.
19' A free kick has been awarded to Real Madrid.
19' Angel Ortiz (Betis) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Alejandro Hernandez didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
18' A quickly taken corner by Real Madrid.

17' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) hits a shot towards the left side of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Alvaro Valles. The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
15' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) is adjudged offside.
13' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
12' Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) brings an opponent down and Alejandro Hernandez interrupts the game. Real Madrid are awarded a free kick.
12' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) tries to get the ball up and over the defensive wall, but they easily block the effort.

11' Marc Roca (Betis) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Real Madrid.
11' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
10' A player from Betis pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Real Madrid have a free kick.
9' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
9' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
8' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
6' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
5' Real Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

5' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Real Madrid are going to take it.
3' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) sends an inaccurate first-time shot that sails miles wide of the right post.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Betis will kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Today's referee will be Alejandro Hernandez.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
